description: This file defines device configurations and build instructions for the Layerscape ARMv7 platform within an OpenWRT build system. It includes device profiles, image build steps, and specific device variants such as TWR-LS1021A and IoT devices. The macros define how images like firmware, sysupgrade, and sdcard images are constructed and handled.

methods.name: Device/Default
methods.description: Defines default build parameters for a device, including profiles, filesystem types, images, kernel options, and image size.

methods.name: Device/fsl-sdboot
methods.description: Defines parameters for devices that boot from SD card, including kernel compression and SD card image creation.

methods.name: Device/fsl_ls1021a-twr
methods.description: Configures a specific device variant with device-specific packages and image assembly steps.

methods.name: Device/fsl_ls1021a-twr-sdboot
methods.description: Specifies SD card boot configurations for the TWR-LS1021A device, including image formatting and partitioning steps.

methods.name: Device/fsl_ls1021a-iot-sdboot
methods.description: Defines SD card boot settings for the IoT variant of the LS1021A device.
